methodologyNotes: Roster covers high-search countertop and nugget ice makers sold in the US residential market. Every product was independently re-verified against primary sources (GE Appliances, NewAir.com, MagicChef.com, Euhomy.com, Govee.com) and the PR Newswire CES 2026 release for GoveeLife, with retailer/review corroboration (Amazon, Lowe's, Reviewed.com, Ice Artisan, The Ice Maker Hub, ShouldIt.com). Prices are MSRP or manufacturer/primary-retailer list price; for discontinued GE Opal models the current GE Appliances sale price is recorded alongside the original MSRP. Boolean specs reflect the base model; null means the feature could not be confirmed (a null beats a guess). Capacity figures are manufacturer-stated unless a testing source corrected them, in which case provenance notes it. All 14 draft products were confirmed to exist; none removed. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: GE Profile Opal 2.0 Nugget Ice Maker (XPIO13SCSS)
products.priceNote: Current GE Appliances sale price ($399, was $599 MSRP); model no longer manufactured
products.provenance: VERIFIED: GE Appliances product page directly shows $399 current price, $599 MSRP, and 'This model is no longer being manufactured.' Dimensions 16.5 H x 13.43 W x 17.5 D confirmed on page. 38 lb/day, 3 lb bin, WiFi via SmartHQ confirmed by GE and Amazon listing B0964BF4N7. First-ice 15 min is the upper bound (GE 'as little as 10 min'; reviewers 10-15). Self-cleaning confirmed (auto-clean cycle). Release year 2022 retained per Amazon first-listing.

products.name: GE Profile Opal 1.0 Nugget Ice Maker (P4INAASSTSS)
products.priceNote: GE Appliances list/clearance price; model discontinued. Some retailers ~$385.
products.provenance: VERIFIED: GE Appliances page confirms $449 (sale), 17.1 H x 9.67 W x 17.3 D, WiFi (SmartHQ), and discontinued status. Daily capacity 34 lb/day and 10-min first ice confirmed by the P4INAASSTSS Amazon listing (B09ZRNP19N) and The Ice Maker Hub review (the latter notes ~$385 street). NOTE: the older OPAL01 side-tank model is rated 24 lb/day, but THIS model (P4INAASSTSS) is the 34 lb/day refresh. Self-cleaning false: Opal 1.0 uses manual descaling, not an auto cycle. Release 2021 approximate.

products.name: Frigidaire EFIC189 Compact Ice Maker
products.priceNote: Typical US retail (~$80-100, Amazon/Newegg); no official MSRP published
products.provenance: VERIFIED: 26 lb/day, 5-6 min per cycle (9 cubes), 1.5 lb bin, 2 bullet sizes, no WiFi, no self-clean confirmed by Amazon listing B075QP7SCP and 888lots spec (11.6 D x 8.7 W x 11.4 H). PRICE CORRECTED 100->90: current US retail is ~$80-100 (Amazon/Newegg ~$89.99), so $90 is more accurate than the draft's $100. ShouldIt measured ~17 lb actual vs 26 lb claim; manufacturer figure used as spec. Release 2017 approximate (ASIN B075QP7SCP).

products.name: Frigidaire EFIC452-SS Clear Square Ice Maker
products.provenance: VERIFIED: 40 lb/day, 24 square cubes in <15 min, 2.4 lb bin, dims 14.8 D x 11 W x 14.1 H confirmed by Amazon listing (explicitly states 14.8"D x 11"W x 14.1"H). Clear square cubes, no WiFi, no self-clean. Price ~$149 confirmed (Walmart $148.56). Release 2018 from ASIN B077MT8TJV.

products.name: Frigidaire EFIC237 Countertop Nugget Ice Maker
products.priceNote: $312.99 per The Ice Maker Hub; Amazon has ranged $312-$349

products.name: NewAir AI-215SS 50 lb Countertop Ice Maker

Storage bin weight not stated by any source; null retained. Release date unverifiable; null.

products.name: NewAir AI-100SS 28 lb Countertop Ice Maker
products.provenance: VERIFIED: NewAir.com confirms $259.99, 28 lb/day, new batch every 10 min, dims 14.60 H x 11.75 W x 13.75 D, 3 bullet sizes, no WiFi, NO self-cleaning function (explicitly listed 'No'). Storage 2.2 lb confirmed by retailer listings. Release date unverifiable; null.

products.name: Igloo ICEB26SS Portable Countertop Ice Maker
products.priceNote: Typical US retail (~$80-100, Amazon/Best Buy/Lowe's); no published MSRP

Base ICEB26SS has NO self-cleaning; the ICEB26HNSS/IGLICEB26HNSS handle variant adds self-cleaning (different model). No WiFi. Release date unverifiable; null.

products.provenance: VERIFIED: MagicChef.com confirms $209, 27 lb/day, 7-min first ice, dims 9.5 W x 14.1 D x 12.9 H, 2 bullet sizes, no WiFi, and 'Sold Out.' products.name: GoveeLife Smart Nugget Ice Maker Pro
products.priceNote: MSRP $499.99 per Govee.com and PR Newswire CES 2026 release
products.provenance: VERIFIED: Govee.com confirms $499.99, 60 lb/day, 6-min first ice, 3.5 lb basket, dual self-clean (10-min quick / 30-min deep), WiFi via GoveeHome with Alexa/Google. Reviewed.com confirms dims 17.28 D x 13.98 W x 17.01 H. PR Newswire release confirms launch Jan 15, 2026 at CES 2026 and $499.99 MSRP. priceUsd 500 retained as rounded MSRP ($499.99).

CORROBORATION REPLACED: the draft's Amazon link (B07R56HW4G) was a different 26 lb bullet machine, not the Pearl H1 nugget; replaced with a topical Pearl H1 review article.
